{{Quote|Lieutenant, I think you've got that backward."<br />"That's right. It is backward. But still correct. Didn't you hear me cite training protocol one-seven-nine?|Kell Tainer and Wes Janson|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
'''Training Protocol 179''' or '''Training Protocol one-seven-nine''' was a training protocol used by the [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Command]]. Used primarily on trainees that have not flown together long; a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] earns all the kills his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] made and vice versa. It sought to encourage cooperation among the trainees.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />
